questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The formal oxidation numbers of $\text{C}\text{r}$ and $\text{C}\text{l}$ in the ions ${Cr}_{2}{O}_{7}^{2 -}$ and $\text{C}\text{l}{O}_{3}^{-}$, respectively are
questions.solution:
In $\text{C}{r}_{2}{O}_{7}^{2 -}$
Let the oxidation state of $\text{C}\text{r}$ be $\text{x}$

$∴ 2\left(x\right) + 7\left(- 2\right) = - 2$

$2\text{x} - 14 = - 2$

$2\text{x} = 12$
$\text{x} = + 6$

In $\text{C}\text{l}{O}_{3}^{-}$

Let the oxidation state of $\text{C}\text{l}$ be $\text{x}$

$∴ 1\left(x\right) + 3\left(- 2\right) = - 1$

$\text{x} - 6 = - 1$
$\text{x} = + 5$

questions.q:
In a titration experiment, $10mL$ of an ${FeCl}_{2}$ solution consumed $25mL$ of a standard ${K}_{2}{Cr}_{2}{O}_{7}$ solution to reach the equivalent point. The standard ${K}_{2}{Cr}_{2}{O}_{7}$ solution is prepared by dissolving $1. 225g$ of ${K}_{2}{Cr}_{2}{O}_{7}$ in $250mL$ water. The concentration of the ${FeCl}_{2}$ solution is closest to

[Given : molecular weight of ${K}_{2}{Cr}_{2}{O}_{7} = 294g{mol}^{- 1}$]
questions.solution:
In titration at equivalence& point, number of equivalents of both reactants must be same.

$∴ {N}_{1}{V}_{1} = {N}_{2}{V}_{2}$

$N$ (normality) of ${FeCl}_{2} = \dfrac{\left(N \times V\right)of{K}_{2}{Cr}_{2}{O}_{7}}{Vof{FeCl}_{2}}$

$N$ (normality) of ${K}_{2}{Cr}_{2}{O}_{7} = \dfrac{Mass \times 1000}{Equivalentmass \times Volumeofsolutionprepared}$

Equivalent mass $= \dfrac{Molarmass}{nfactor}$

$= \dfrac{294}{6}$

$= 49g / equi.$

(${K}_{2}{Cr}_{2}{O}_{7}$ as oxidising agent is reduced to $2{Cr}^{3 +}$).

Oxidation state of $2Cr$ atoms change from $+ 6$ to $+ 3$.

Total change is$3 \times 2 = 6$, ($∴ n$-factor $= 6$)

$∴ N$ (of ${K}_{2}{Cr}_{2}{O}_{7}$) $= \dfrac{1225 \times 1000}{49 \times 250} = 0. 1N$

$∴ N$ (of ${FeCl}_{2}$) $= \dfrac{0. 1 \times 25}{10}$

$= 0. 25N$
